tags.laws: DERIVED (static pressure-area; no flow-momentum, approach-velocity or flashing terms) - bounds, not a prediction
tags.throttle_map: SIM grain_q1d.py v2 (S230, nominal ASSUMED regression law, Dyer pintle Cd 0.70); P1 = Pc (1 + dP/Pc) as simulated
tags.mechanical_model: Mechanical pintle_inline_v34.py v2 friction/spring/crank model (ASSUMED frictions), re-run with replaced F_po only

unlit_note: P1 = tank pressure (no line loss at crack; with full-stroke flow the line loss lowers P1); 5.05 MPa = saturated N2O at 20 C (CoolProp, combustion.json), 7.0 MPa = tank MEOP (LEAD v0). Cold flow and the start before Pc rises are these cases.

mechanical_C1_C2_rerun.P_down: ambient (cold flow / unlit full stroke to the 4.2 mm stop); hot fire lowers the closing force (P_down = Pc), see flight_line_C2

flight_line_C2.note: servo opening torque (+10 % spring, Mechanical friction model) at each throttle_map_v2 state, D_port 25 mm, P_tank 35-55 bar; the start before Pc rises is the unlit case at the ignition lift (<= 0.3 mm)

seat_breakout_C2.note: crack-open torque (+10 % spring, Mechanical friction model incl. guide amplification) with the wedge break-out of a self-locking 15 deg seat; mu_seat ASSUMED range (dry 17-4PH self-mated ~0.4-0.6 AS RECALLED; PFPE-lubricated lower)
